offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures medical devices for hospitals, clinicians and patients, including vascular access, interventional, surgical and anesthesia products. Sells mainly through direct sales teams and distributors, with products made in company facilities and by outside manufacturers.

primary_products.value: vascular access catheters; interventional catheters and guidewires; surgical instruments; anesthesia and respiratory devices; urology devices

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, physicians, group purchasing organizations

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals and surgical care; interventional procedures

revenue_model.value: product sales: single-use and reusable medical devices sold to hospitals and clinics

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes medical devices, sold to hospitals and distributors; brand owner: markets its own branded medical device lines to clinicians and health systems

geography_served.value: global: worldwide sales, with major markets in North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: vascular access, interventional, surgical, anesthesia and respiratory, and urology device lines sharing hospital customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams calling on hospitals, surgeons and group purchasing organizations; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors in markets without direct sales coverage

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance or approval and EU medical device regulation compliance

notes: Recent divestitures may mean some listed product lines are no longer current, so the portfolio description may be out of date.
